name: ENS Kalari
summary: ENS Kalari is a kalaripayattu school at Nettoor, Kochi, established in 1954, teaching both the northern and southern styles. Visitors can watch demonstrations, take short courses or book traditional kalari treatments.
highlights: Teaches both northern and southern kalaripayattu
Traditional kalari marma treatments and oil massage
Authorised by the Ernakulam District Tourism Promotion Council
